texts:
Four teams are on bye, and the Week 6 wire has one real backfield and a few receivers who just took on targets.

Woody Marks, claim 15 to 25 percent.
Germie Bernard, claim 3 to 6 percent.
Keenan Allen, claim 3 to 6 percent.

Let's get to it.
#HTownMade #HereWeGo #ForTheShoe

1. Woody Marks, HOU RB: 56 of 65 snaps at TEN after David Montgomery left, 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches. No other Houston back touched it.

Claim him, 15 to 25 percent.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

David Montgomery, HOU RB: DeMeco Ryans calls the groin week to week.

RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report; Marks is the London back if he sits.
#HTownMade

2. Germie Bernard, PIT WR: 28 routes, tied for the team high, and a team-high 9 targets vs IND, 6 for 80.

Pittman is on IR and Roman Wilson misses multiple weeks. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

3. Keenan Allen, IND WR: 9 targets in each of his last two games, at least 5 catches each time.

Alec Pierce is on IR. WR60 rest of season for me. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp

4. Ollie Gordon II, MIA RB: 18 carries for 88 and a TD on 43 snaps vs CIN. Jaylen Wright ran 6 times.

Miami is on bye, so he may still be there. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent, and hold through the bye.
#PhinsUp #WhoDey

5. MarShawn Lloyd, GB RB: 26 snaps to Pierre Strong's 24 and the goal-line work vs CHI, 2 TDs.

Chris Brooks is on IR. RB41 rest of season for me. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

6. Kendrick Bourne, ARI WR: 5 of 8 targets for 70 vs DET, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is now a Texan.

The second outside job is his @LAR. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

7. Tyjae Spears, TEN RB: over half the snaps for the first time and 9 catches vs HOU.

A PPR flex in 14-team leagues @IND. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.
#TitanUp

8. Efton Chism III, NE WR: a team-high 6 targets vs LV, 5 for 57, with Hollins on IR.

A.J. Brown may return to practice this week. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent; monitor Brown's practice window.
#NEPats #JetUp

Tight ends.

Brenton Strange, JAX TE: 14 of 16 targets for 163 the last two weeks, a team-high 26 percent share. TE16 rest of season for me. Claim him, 2 to 4 percent.
#DUUUVAL

Chig Okonkwo, WAS TE: a team-high 6 targets vs NYG, 4 for 60, with Jayden Daniels back.

TE23 rest of season for me. A Monday night streamer @SF. Add him, 0 to 2 percent.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Quarterback streamers for the bye week.

Jordan Love, GB QB: 367 yards vs CHI, 4 TDs and 77 percent completions the last two games. Stream him vs DAL, 3 to 6 percent.
#GoPackGo #DallasCowboys

Aaron Rodgers, PIT QB: 3 TD passes in three straight games.

Stream him @TB, 1 to 3 percent, if your quarterback is on bye.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Stashes.

Zach Charbonnet, SEA RB: still on PUP, limited Monday, not expected Thursday @DEN. Stash him, 3 to 6 percent.

Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB: 20 carries vs SF. Hold him for Thursday.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

Dylan Sampson, CLE RB: eligible to come off IR this week, and Quinshon Judkins is day to day with the ankle. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.

Judkins is RB20 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Samaje Perine, CIN RB: out-carried Chase Brown 14 to 13 at MIA with a TD. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.

Chase Brown, CIN RB: 22 carries for 49 in two games. RB6 rest of season for me. Hold him through the bye.
#WhoDey

Dameon Pierce, PHI RB: 11 carries for 14 yards in London. Stash him for Barkley managers, 1 to 3 percent.

Saquon Barkley, PHI RB: Sirianni is hopeful for CAR. RB9 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report.
#FlyEaglesFly #KeepPounding

Cut bait.

Will Shipley, PHI RB: partial plantar fascia tear, multiple weeks. Drop him.

Roman Wilson, PIT WR: finger, multiple weeks, and Bernard has the routes. Drop him.
#FlyEaglesFly #HereWeGo

More cuts.

Jaylen Wright, MIA RB: 6 carries for 11 while Gordon took 18. Drop him.

Pat Freiermuth, PIT TE: 2 TDs on 5 catches for 44. TE27 rest of season for me. Drop him.
#PhinsUp #HereWeGo

Keon Coleman, BUF WR: DJ Moore sat Monday night and Coleman still drew 2 targets. Drop him.

DJ Moore, BUF WR: WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor the shoulder at Wednesday's practice report.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

Monday night: Buffalo won 37-34 in overtime. Josh Allen ran for 121, and James Cook ran 25 times for 111 and 2 TDs with a lost fumble.

Cook is RB7 rest of season for me. Hold him.
#BillsMafia #RamsHouse

Tyler Higbee, LAR TE: 5 of 6 for 83 while Puka Nacua drew 24 targets, 17 for 138 and a TD.

One game does not make Higbee a stream vs ARI. Leave him on waivers.
#RamsHouse #BirdGang

Every add, stash and drop with the full FAAB read is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu tomorrow and the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/market.html?week=6
